input.text: Notably, Marciscano et al. compared tumor-directed stereotactic RT with or without elective nodal irradiation (ENI) in a preclinical model and showed that tumor RT alone upregulated an intratumoral CXCR3/CCR5-related T-cell chemoattractant signature and drove robust infiltration of antigen-specific CD8+ effector T cells (together with FoxP3+ Tregs), yielding favorable intratumoral CD8+ effector-to-Treg ratios, whereas the addition of ENI attenuated this chemokine signature, restrained immune infiltration and abrogated the survival benefit of RT combined with immune checkpoint blockade, most conspicuously with anti-CTLA-4 35. These data support the view that the magnitude of the CD8+ T-cell response recruited by RT-based regimens, rather than STING activation alone, determines the immunological outcome, and are consistent with our finding that the anlotinib/IR/anti-PD-L1 combination amplified intratumoral CD8+ T-cell infiltration and immune memory without irradiating the draining lymph nodes.

Abstract
Radiation resistance and unsatisfactory efficacy of radioimmunotherapy are important barriers to non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) treatment. The impacts of anlotinib on radiation and tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) in NSCLC remain to be resolved. Here, we find anlotinib enhances radiosensitivity, and further increases radiotherapy-stimulated CD8+ T cell infiltration and activation via triggering cGAS/STING pathway. Moreover, anlotinib shows significant effects on radioimmunotherapy (radiotherapy plus anti-PD-L1). Our work reveals the crucial role of anlotinib in antitumor immunity, and provides preclinical evidence for the application of anlotinib combined with radioimmunotherapy in NSCLC treatment.

已改好并同名覆盖保存（备份在原文件旁的 `manuscript.docx.bak`）。改动以**修订模式**记录，需要在 Word 里接受。

## 改了什么

在 Discussion 开头段（"Accumulating evidence suggests that the infiltration and activation of CD8+ T cells…"，原文以 "additional preclinical and prospective studies are required in this field." 结尾）**末尾新增了两句**：

1. **与 Marciscano 等的比较句**：说明该研究比较了「肿瘤定向立体定向放疗 ± 选择性淋巴结照射（ENI）」，发现单纯肿瘤放疗上调瘤内 CXCR3/CCR5 相关 T 细胞趋化因子谱、驱动抗原特异性 CD8⁺ 效应 T 细胞（及 FoxP3⁺ Treg）大量浸润、形成较有利的瘤内 CD8⁺ 效应/Treg 比值；而加用 ENI 后趋化因子表达受抑、免疫浸润受限，并削弱了 RT + ICB 的生存获益，尤以 anti-CTLA-4 联合时最明显。引用了文中已有的文献编号 **35**（参考文献表第 35 条正是 Marciscano 2018, Clin Cancer Res 24:5058-71），无需新增文献。
2. **一句衔接语**：把上述结果与本研究「三药联合（anlotinib/IR/anti-PD-L1）在不照射引流淋巴结的情况下增强瘤内 CD8⁺ T 细胞浸润与免疫记忆」的发现对照，收束该段。

## 关于「具体数据」——需要你确认

我检索了 PubMed/Europe PMC 上该文（PMID 29898992，DOI 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-17-3427），目前只能拿到**摘要**，摘要中只有定性表述（趋化因子谱、CD8⁺/Treg 比值、ENI 削弱 anti-CTLA-4 联合疗效），**没有任何具体数值**（如小鼠长期生存比例、CD8⁺ T 细胞密度或瘤体积的具体数字）。摘要以外的正文/图数据我无法核实。

因此我**没有**按"凭记忆写数字"来填——这类精确数值一旦写错，就是给稿子埋一个审稿人一查即穿的错误引用，风险远大于这一句的分量。所以该句现为定性比较，未编造百分比或生存天数。

如果你手上有 PDF，请把相关结果段或图注发我（比如 Tumor RT vs ENI + anti-CTLA-4 的长期生存小鼠比例、瘤内抗原特异性 CD8⁺ 细胞密度或 CD8/Treg 比值），我立刻把那句改成带确切数字的版本。另外，若期刊要求引用处用上标，我可以把新增的 "35" 一并设为上标格式。

   - 现在：…cancer-related deaths worldwide **⁴⁰**. Non-small cell lung cancer…

2. **参考文献表末尾新增第 40 条**（接在原第 39 条 Dunphy 之后，沿用 `EndNoteBibliography` 样式与"序号.作者. 题名. 期刊. 年;卷:页. doi:"的格式）

> 40.Bray F, Ferlay J, Soerjomataram I, Siegel RL, Torre LA, Jemal A. Global cancer statistics 2018: GLOBOCAN estimates of incidence and mortality worldwide for 36 cancers in 185 countries. CA Cancer J Clin. 2018;68:394-424. doi:10.3322/caac.21492

**为什么选这一条**：这句里的 11.6% 和"首要癌症死因"正是 GLOBOCAN 2018 的原始数据（原文摘要即"In both sexes combined, lung cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer (11.6% of the total cases) and the leading cause of cancer death (18.4%)"），我已通过文献检索核对到 DOI 10.3322/caac.21492 / PMID 30207593。

**一点需要您确认的地方**：原稿参考文献是按正文出现顺序编号的，严格来说这条应排为第 1 条、其后全部顺延。但这篇稿子的文内引用全是 EndNote 域（每个域里存了缓存编号），改动全部编号会牵动 39 条文献条目和约 30 处域内编号，容易与 EndNote 库失去同步。因此我采取了风险最小的做法：把它续编为 40 并在正文标注 40。若您希望我按"出现顺序"整体重排编号（1→2→…）我也可以做，或者更稳妥的办法是在 EndNote 里插入该条目后点一次 Update Citations and Bibliography 自动重排。
